order.title: Choose how to order your path
order.body: Switch between the defensible order (biggest risk and legal exposure first) and the chronological view.

filters.title: Filter by status
filters.body: Narrow the list down to what's overdue, due soon, or waiting on a sign-off.

columns.title: Columns show who owns it
columns.body: Each column groups requirements by the role responsible for handling them.

legend.title: Understand the dots
legend.body: Each dot's color and fill show a requirement's status at a glance: open, in progress, awaiting sign-off, or signed off.

firstNode.title: This is a requirement
firstNode.body: Click any card to open that requirement and see exactly what to do next.

status.title: Track your status
status.body: This badge shows whether the requirement is open, in progress, or signed off.

form.title: Fill in the specifics
form.body: Click Edit to answer the questions for this requirement, then Save your answers.

evidence.title: Attach evidence
evidence.body: Upload the documents that prove this control is actually in place.

assign.title: Assign and sign off
assign.body: Assign an owner for this requirement, then sign off once it's met.

nav.title: Move through your path
nav.body: Use Prev/Next to step through requirements in order, or mark one Not Applicable if it doesn't apply to you.
